title: Decision Signal Router
purpose: Map host-validated normalized field-change signals to the active decision watches whose condition paths are affected.

matching.field_path_rule: A signal matches a watch when a changed field equals, is an ancestor of, or is a descendant of the watch condition field, using dot-separated path boundaries.

host_flow: Authenticate and validate the source event in the host adapter.
Map it to a payload-free DecisionSignal with canonical field paths.
Load candidate watches within the signal company and decision subject.
Route the signal, then let the host persist and deduplicate returned cycle requests.
Invoke Step 26 runDecisionWatchCycle for each accepted event request.
invariants: The router does not consume raw event payloads or browser transport messages.
The router never evaluates a watch condition or loads decision evidence.
Only active watches within the exact company and decision-subject scope can be routed.
Missing changed-field metadata cannot fan out across every watch.
The router does not enqueue, persist, notify, authorize, approve, or dispatch.
host_owned_components: source authentication, bridge transport, and event normalization
